generatedFrom.title: Carding — buying with stolen cards
generatedFrom.narrative: An attacker putting a list of stolen cards through checkout at real prices, to buy goods rather than just prove the cards are live.
generatedFrom.correlation: One session, one device, one network; many distinct cards, almost none approved — the same enumeration shape at ordinary amounts.
generatedFrom.recommendedAction: Contain it. The loss here is real goods shipped against a stolen card, not one inconvenienced shopper.
generatedFrom.difficulty: Looks like ordinary purchasing on transaction size alone — the tell is the card-to-attempt spread and the near-zero approval, not the amount. A detector keyed on small-amount probing misses it.
